study_design: Prospective population-based cohort study using Cox proportional hazards modeling over eight years
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A total of 1,179,172 Korean men who were cancer free from 1996 to 1997, had taken a physical examination, and completed a lifestyle questionnaire, were enrolled in our study to predict their risk for PC for the next eight years, using the Cox proportional hazards model.
reason: The study follows cancer-free men for incident prostate cancer but does not define or analyze an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incidence endpoint in the abstract.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The model performed very well (C statistic, 0.887; 95% confidence interval, 0.879 to 0.895) and estimated an elevated PC risk in patients who did not consume alcohol or smoke, compared to heavy alcohol consumers (hazard ratio [HR], 0.78) and current smokers (HR, 0.73) (p < 0.001).
